title: 第1章 出生在金发美女的浴室里
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“结束了，我的海贼生涯……”

林北，穿越到海贼世界两年半。

没有金手指，没有系统，没有随身老爷爷。被贵族压迫，被海贼掠夺。

好不容易加入了一个小有名气的海贼团，只为出海讨口饭吃。

结果船长偏偏不长眼，非要和来东海度假的红发香克斯碰一碰。

一刀！就一刀！

全员覆没，他也跟着没了。

堂堂穿越者，死得像个背景板……好不甘心啊！

一道白光闪过。

林北猛地从椅子上弹起。

周围是一片纯白色的空间，没有墙壁，没有地板，却又能站立、能呼吸。

“我这是……在哪？”

“林北先生，欢迎来到死后的世界。”

清泉般的声音响起。

他猛地抬头，随即呼吸一滞。

——好美！

少女水蓝色的长发轻灵柔和，淡紫色的羽衣熠熠生辉，超凡脱俗的容颜，让林北瞬间理解了何为“不可直视的美”。

但随着头脑逐渐清醒，他很快就高兴不起来了。

这张脸他认识，或者说，任何一个对异世界题材有所涉猎的地球人都认识。

传说中的水之智慧女神——

“阿库娅？！”

阿库娅歪着头，狐疑地打量着他。

“我们……见过？”

“呃……”林北急中生智，“我是阿库西斯教的信徒，生前见过您的雕像。”

“那为什么我在你身上感受不到一丁点信仰？”

林北信誓旦旦：“厄里斯的胸，是垫出来的。”

二人相视一笑，随即重重点头。

这家伙……果然和传闻中的一样好糊弄。

“那……我可爱的信徒，闲聊就到此为止吧。”

阿库娅站起身来，双手交叠放在身前，摆出端庄的仪态。

虽然林北怎么看都觉得违和。

“初次见面……”

“跳过。”

“哎？！为什么？这可是女神的自我介绍！”

“既然互相认识，干脆直接进入正题吧。”

Page (1/3)

"It's over, my pirate career..."

Lin Bei, traveled to the world of pirates for two and a half years.

There is no golden finger, no system, and no portable grandfather.Oppressed by nobles and plundered by pirates.

Finally, he joined a slightly famous pirate group, just to go out to sea and beg for food.

It turns out that the captain is not very discerning and insists on meeting the red-haired Shanks who is on vacation in the East China Sea.

One knife!Just one knife!

Everyone was wiped out, and he was gone with him.

The dignified time-traveler died like a backdrop... so unwilling to accept it!

A flash of white light flashed.

Lin Bei suddenly jumped up from his chair.

Surrounded by a pure white space, there are no walls or floors, but you can stand and breathe.

"Where am I...?"

"Mr. Lin Bei, welcome to the world after death."

A sound like a clear spring sounded.

He looked up suddenly, and his breath hitched.

--What a nice view!

The girl's aqua-blue long hair was light and soft, her lavender feathers were shining, and her otherworldly appearance made Lin Bei instantly understand what "beauty that cannot be seen directly" is.

But as his mind gradually cleared, he soon lost his joy.

He knew this face, or in other words, anyone on Earth who was interested in otherworldly themes would know it.

The legendary goddess of water wisdom——

"Aqua?!"

Aqua tilted her head and looked at him suspiciously.

"We...have met?"

"Uh..." Lin Bei said in a hurry, "I am a believer in the Axis Cult and I have seen your statue before my death."

"Then why can't I feel any faith in you?"

Lin Bei vowed: "Eris's breasts are made from pads."

The two looked at each other and smiled, then nodded heavily.

This guy... is indeed as easy to fool as the rumors say.

"Then...my lovely believer, let's stop chatting here."

Aqua stood up, folded her hands in front of her, and assumed a dignified manner.

Although Lin Bei felt it was inconsistent no matter how he looked at it.

"First meeting..."

"Skip."

"Hey?! Why? This is the goddess's self-introduction!"

"Since we know each other, let's get straight to the point."
